entities.name: Spring and Autumn Period
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Spring and Autumn Period, a transformative movement in China (771 BCE–476 BCE). Emerged from King Wu and Mandate of Heaven. Catalyzed Confucius born in the state of Lu; his teachings shape Chinese civilization and Sun Tzu composes The Art of War.
